name: Grasslands Turf
description: Turf and topsoil supplier site with an online shop, trade accounts and practical lawn-care tools.
features: Custom "grasslands" theme driven by an ACF Flexible Content page builder with 13 layouts, including a numbered turf-laying timeline
Turf and soil quantity calculators plus a lawn-care calendar, built as page templates
[inferred] WooCommerce shop with Stripe payments, role-based payment methods and multiple delivery addresses
[inferred] Trade account sign-up through Gravity Forms User Registration, with Sage accounting sync
evidence: Project CLAUDE.md (flexible content layouts); local theme files (calculator-turf.php, calculator-soil.php, page-lawn-calendar.php, page-trade-sign-up.php); local plugins folder (activation not verified)

name: Performance Pathways
description: School sport education platform with lessons, CPD courses and resources designed by UK coaches, behind a member dashboard.
features: Custom "performance-patways" theme with a logged-in member dashboard
Custom post types for lessons, classes, CPD courses, content and contributors
Nine custom taxonomies (level, subject, school year, learning pathway, equipment and more) for filtering the resource library
[inferred] Demo bookings and enquiries handled through Gravity Forms
evidence: Homepage asset paths; public REST API /wp/v2/types, /wp/v2/taxonomies and namespaces (gf/v2, cptui/v1)

name: Khuvsgul Lake Research Hub

features: Custom "smartc" theme on an HTML5 Blank base, with an ACF section builder (timeline, gallery, team, posts carousel and more)
Scroll-driven hero that zooms from a 3D-rendered globe down to the lake, using five pre-built imagery layers
Custom post types for publications, Russian-language publications, data portal, news, media, projects and announcements
ACF field groups saved to acf-json so content structure is version-controlled
evidence: Local theme files (template-home.php, tools/build-hero-layers.php, acf-json, template-parts/sections); public REST API /wp/v2/types
